title: Draw bootstrap samples and average the stumps
brief: Draw n rows with replacement, fit one stump per draw, and average the stumps' predictions.
hints: bootstrap_indices is one call: rng.integers(0, n, size=n). Every entry is an independent draw from 0 to n - 1, so repeats are expected.
In fit_bagged_stumps, draw idx once per estimator, fit _fit_stump(X[idx], y[idx]), and append both the stump and idx. The next chapter needs idx to know which rows each stump missed.
bagged_predict stacks one prediction vector per stump into an array of shape (len(stumps), n), then averages down axis 0.
